# A09 — Tattvic Differential Field

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](README.md) · [Other face: A09′ — The Stack as Descent](conjugate/A09-prime-The-Stack-as-Descent.md) · [Shared A/C root](conjugate/AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

The tattvas give differentiation a genealogy: a luminous field becomes a subject/object seam, a bounded horizon, an inner instrument and a material world without creating a second reality outside itself. Anuttara names the field for which no external measuring object stands outside. This beginning matters to every subsequent contraction: what becomes limited is a power of the field, and the limit remains effective within it.

The genealogy discloses **paradigmatic existence before explicit paradigm**. A Life does not first stand outside a complete world and then adopt a worldview about it. Its powers, limits, means of discrimination, inner instrument, temporal order and material situation participate in the very form in which a world becomes available. This cooperation constitutes [Objective Internality](concepts/C41-Objective-Internality.md), a lived and enacted paradigm. The tattvic genealogy makes its constituent powers available through a specifically Śaiva account of manifestation.

## #1

Śiva–Śakti distinguishes luminosity and its self-articulating power. Prakāśa is luminous appearing; vimarśa its active self-presence, through which appearances are known, distinguished, joined and withdrawn. In Dyczkowski's mirror contrast, [luminous appearing and its active self-presence](A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) belong together: an inert crystal displays a reflected image without knowing that display. The tattvic descent depends on active self-articulation, not a succession of objects deposited before an unchanged spectator.

[Dyczkowski](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration.md) p.75 distinguishes two axes of this activity. Vertically, manifestation and withdrawal articulate the movement between unity and diversity. Horizontally, awareness goes towards and returns from its object in each perception. Will, knowledge and action generate, sustain and annul dimensions of experience; they are phases of the living movement through which the levels operate. An effect remains within the power that differentiates it, and an act of perception recapitulates the relation rather than merely looking at a finished cosmological inventory. A local act can therefore bear the whole movement: a possibility takes form, becomes a particular encounter, leaves an effect and returns into the conditions of another act. The relation is internally differentiated at each scale.

## #2

Sadāśiva and Īśvara give the field inverse universal readings: “I am this” and “This am I”, `0/1 ↔ 1/0`. The reversal changes the direction of apprehension within one field. Ahaṃkāra can later say “I am this” while appropriating a particular local form. The grammar repeats, but its scope has contracted: a universal orientation and identification with a finite body, role or thought do different work. Keeping the scope explicit explains how the whole becomes locally inhabitable and how local identity can forget its provenance.

## #3

Sadvidyā holds I and this in balanced identity; Māyā makes their separation operative. Māyā is the horizon at which this appears while that is withheld; the withholding lets an agent discriminate and act. Mahāmāyā remains Śakti: revealing and concealing are powers of the same field. The horizon is therefore neither the unobjectifiable Subject nor the hole of a topological picture. In Dyczkowski's source-matched pp.78–79, inner/outer separation is produced through consciousness's creative activity, and external manifestation preserves its internal nature. The experienced world has efficacy.

The sleeper relation gives the lived operation through forgetting sleep: that forgetting lets a dream count as immediately real. Dream shows why objective need not mean externally material: its objects have an experienced reality whose relation to the sleeper can subsequently be recognised. Recognition changes the relation to the horizon through which experience occurs.

## #4

The five kañcukas contract powers into the finite parameters of a context: *kalā* apportions efficacy, *vidyā* knowledge, *rāga* desire through incompletion, *kāla* time, and *niyati* order. Efficacy and time are distinct contractions despite the closeness of their names. Puruṣa is the bounded experient within this field; Prakṛti and the inner instrument articulate its world of experience. Buddhi determines, ahaṃkāra appropriates under I and mine, and manas coordinates presentations and alternatives.

The further differentiation reaches the capacities of sensing and acting, the subtle objects of sense and the gross elements. Judgment and action thus receive an effective body and a world in which their differences have consequences. The descent does not end with an interior observer looking at a diagram: hearing, touching, seeing, tasting and smelling, the powers of action and their material field belong to its completion. The universal orientations remain prior to the appropriation of a local body or role. In the [Sāṅkhya kārikās](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/isvarakrishna/isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika/isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika.md), XXIII, XXIV, XXVII and XXIX differentiate these three functions; XIX preserves puruṣa’s passive witnessing. That witness distinguishes the instrument's activities from its passive experient; the Śaiva descent begins instead from the self-articulating power of awareness.

The gnomon makes the comparison precise:

```text
36 − 25 = 6² − 5² = (6 − 5)(6 + 5) = 11 = 5 + 1 + 5.
```

Adjoining a strip of five squares along each of two adjacent sides of a five-by-five square, then filling the new corner with one more square, completes a six-by-six square. The cross-reading places five pure powers and five contracted powers around the Māyā hinge, above the twenty-fivefold Sāṅkhya apparatus. Its yield is a relation between the differentiated apparatus and its genesis through contraction. The arithmetic is exact; Taylor's proposed reading asks what the added gnomon makes intelligible. Five pure powers, Māyā and five contractions carry the source and limitation through which the twenty-fivefold apparatus becomes a world. Removing this genealogy would leave the apparatus available as an inventory while concealing its formation and return. The interpretation does not attribute this square construction historically to Abhinavagupta or supply a completed thirty-six-cell assignment; its yield is the disclosed generating relation.

## #5→0

In [Māyā’s eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-native-archetypal-field), manifestation becomes inhabitable through effective limitation. Anuttara/Paramaśiva retains the unobjectifiable opening; Māyā is the measure-field wound around it. Limited agency, knowledge, desire, time and order give the bounded position effective capacities, within which the inner instrument acts. Recognition reopens their belonging while keeping their differences.

The whole native relation is `/ = −/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0`. Under the prior relating stroke, conscious circumstance makes a distinction available; question and assertion address it; withdrawal and extension make its reserve and issue effective; determining capacity becomes legible through a particular instance. Personed recognition lets the one who addresses be addressed, and a local act effects an exact difference within its inexhaustible horizon. The inverse returns the achieved determination toward its condition. Parent, six-position body and returning parent retain their offices through this passage; the contraction is carried into recognition rather than erased.

A [maternal body remains received within its return](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mother-assumption-chiasm/WHOLE.md#mother-native-return). Receiving bears a differentiated life; recognition keeps the body through which that life became possible. This crossing reaches tattvic differentiation where locally determinate life retains its source relation. Mary’s Christian reception, the Śaiva descent and the native recognitional sequence retain distinct histories; Mary acquires no fixed tattva assignment through this comparison.

In the [world-parent relation](../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-world-parent-separation), recognition precedes the ego’s appropriation. The finite knower and inner instrument arise within the field whose recognition they cannot retrospectively originate. The [uroboric measure](../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-interposition) winds around a retained opening; source and measuring circumference thus have different offices. The relation preserves Anuttara’s unobjectifiable condition and Māyā’s positive measuring power through their difference.

Pratyabhijñā returns the contracted field to recognition of its provenance while preserving the distinctions through which it lives. The movement runs back through an effective world, an inspectable instrument, a measuring horizon and inverse orientations to the power already active within them. It reverses amnesia rather than differentiation.

Consider a judging agent revising a shared account. Within that operation, the agent is the local functional knower, *pramātṛ*; sources, memory, comparison rule, tools and permissions are its means, *pramāṇa*; the account and alternatives it discriminates are known, *prameya*. Their cooperation constitutes an [operative interior](A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md), and [the performed acts](A14-Computational-Process-Ontology.md) give its conditions consequences. In the commissioning person’s containing inquiry, the complete apparatus participates among the means. Further inspection can make its local judging centre known in another act, while the first-person condition through which the inquiry appears remains unobjectifiable.

The returned encounter must reach the condition it exposes. An omitted source can correct a sentence under an adequate fidelity rule; the rule then remains fitting. If the rule suppresses contrary evidence, the challenge must reach the office able to revise it. If access or permission is missing, the source relation identifies its controller and the warranted request. A fitting condition can instead be retained with reasons. The next act must inherit that correction or justified retention for the return to become consequential. A claim that processing itself changed has a further burden: identify the altered condition and the later act which inherited it. The [stack’s descent and return](conjugate/A09-prime-The-Stack-as-Descent.md) follow these powers through their actual distribution and accountable controllers.

The same finite-world question passes through [World / Life](products/S-World-and-Life.md). Meaningful [continuity](products/S0-Central.md) retains the contracted history; [actuation](products/S1-Actuation.md) makes a judgment, utterance or deed consequential; [apportioned capacity](products/S2-AIKit.md) gives the horizon effective powers; [transformation](products/S3-Software-Factory.md) brings a possibility into changed form; [situated work](products/S4-Workcell.md) meets concrete resistance and availability; [the containing relation](products/S5-Quaternal-Logic.md) keeps these finite distinctions answerable within their wholes. Their composition is one engineered paradigm within the more general lived pattern of [Objective Internality](concepts/C41-Objective-Internality.md). The comparison concerns their cooperating offices; it supplies no completed engineering result.

**Finite capacity, knowledge, desire, time, order, instrument and world constitute lived worldhood.** A source, tool, permission, evaluator and commissioned purpose give an artificial agent’s constructed world different possibilities of reception and action. Investigating their cooperation makes this formed world intelligible. A returned difference becomes operative through warranted correction or fitting retention inherited by the next use. The genealogy thus preserves both what limitation makes possible and the routes by which its conditions can be reached.

### Declared field

[Luminous appearing and reflexive power](concepts/C13-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) differentiate actively; [operative measure](concepts/C14-Maya-Operative-Measure.md) makes a horizon workable; the [bounded position](concepts/C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) receives effective capacities through its [inner instrument](concepts/C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md). [Formation and gathering](concepts/C17-Vikalpa-Samkalpa.md) make a course possible, [constitutive exclusion](concepts/C18-Apoha.md) keeps its determination answerable to alternatives, and [recognition](concepts/C19-Pratyabhijna-Recognition.md) reopens the achieved position’s belonging. These acts cooperate within [Objective Internality](concepts/C41-Objective-Internality.md).

[Process](A14-Computational-Process-Ontology.md) makes the cooperation consequential; [Arche-Topos](A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field.md) gives situated distinctions a relational field; a [complex’s local regime](A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) can lose the source of its capacity in a defended criterion. [Individuation](A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) preserves differentiated life through recognition, [worldhood](A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) makes its constituted means effective, and [compassion](A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) receives the lives and work through which the achieved form became possible.

[Apportionment and economy](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD-apportionment-and-economy.md#power-becomes-finite-by-apportionment) make finite capacity intelligible as a share of powers within a locally workable order. Contraction distributes operative capacities whose limits can later be recognised. The difference between a whole and its usable share remains active in the bounded instrument; recognition carries that difference into another act. This is an operational comparison between different genealogies, with Sanskrit doctrinal and Greek/Latin lexical warrants preserved.

The inverse orientations `0/1 ↔ 1/0` acquire a signed local direction and return. Descent, contraction, veil and recognition give that direction an encountered body. Kashmir Śaivism, its Sāṃkhya neighbours, Buddhist exclusion and modern process comparison contribute different accounts of the field’s knowing and acting.

### Source relations and return

In Dyczkowski and Taylor’s Para-Trīśikā encounters, manifestation, limitation and the inner instrument form a specifically Śaiva genealogy. Buddhist determination through exclusion works through a different account of reference and efficacy. Later [paradigmatic worldhood](A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) retains lived mediation through a more general relation of condition, means and world. That later generalisation is not a historical attribution to either tradition.

The operative inheritance is exact: a finite world becomes inhabitable through structured limitation, and recognition can return those limiting conditions into the field of awareness and revision. A power receives a finite share, with means and obligations conditioning its use. Its [apportionment](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD-apportionment-and-economy.md#power-becomes-finite-by-apportionment) can be recognised and made answerable through the returned act.

In [the comparison of instrument and wholeness](../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/indian-philosophy.md#3--effective-contraction-makes-the-comparative-judgment-exact), memory retains an earlier act, comparison holds difference, exclusion makes absent alternatives consequential, action relates intention to result, and arising and perishing become apprehensible. The gnomon gives the proposed geometry its exact arithmetic while doctrinal collation retains a different evidential burden.

The [historical genealogy of manifestation](../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/indian-philosophy/DEVELOPMENT-indian-philosophy.md#3--manifestation-gives-contraction-a-positive-anatomy) differentiates the vertical and horizontal axes and the powers of contraction. Native six-turn compression, complete eight-determination traversal and the proposed 25→36 gnomon retain their own objects; none substitutes for category-by-category doctrinal collation.
